text:
Sophie: Morning pulse — quick check on tomorrow's LinkedIn/X posts for the product launch. Need final hero image and CTA copy. Who's grabbing assets?
Luis: I can export the hero today, ETA 2pm PT.
Margot: Copy ideas: 1) Short lead-gen CTA 2) Benchmark stat highlight 3) Webinar invite with CTA. Leaning to option 3 for LinkedIn.
Ben: For X thread, plan is: teaser + 3 follow-ups. Draft thread below:
```
Tweet 1: Tease the new capability + link
Tweet 2: Share benchmark stat + short insight
Tweet 3: Webinar CTA + register link (utm params)
```
Tia: Assigning follow-ups — can we route inbound leads to the Marketo form? Also need landing page with UTM.
Sophie: Good call. @Ben pls add UTM params: utm_source=x, utm_campaign=launch_velocity
Luis: hero done -> uploaded to /assets/launch/hero-v3.png :thumbsup:
Margot: Webinar plan: 20min demo + 10min Q&A. Are speakers confirmed? @Sophie
Sophie: Confirmed: Priya + Dan. Schedule 11:00am PT next Wed. @marketing-bot please create calendar invite.
marketing-bot: Created event "Launch: Product demo + Q&A" Wed 11:00 PT. Link: https://cal.example.com/ev/abc123 :calendar:
Ben: Engagement follow-ups flow: 1) DM registrants w/ reminder 2) Post-webinar NPS + replay 3) SDR outreach for high-intent leads.
Tia: For lead routing, route 'high' to SDR queue, 'warm' to nurture. We'll tag via form fields: intent_score (0-100).
Sophie: Copy tweak suggestion for X headline: "See it in action — join the 20min demo". Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Margot: I'll A/B test: "See it in action" vs "Quick demo" on LinkedIn.
Luis: Asset note: added mobile-first crop as hero-v3-mobile.png and a smaller 1200x628 version.
Ben: I'll schedule posts in Buffer. Tentative times: X 9:30am PT, LinkedIn 10:00am PT.
Sophie: Approvals: @Ed (legal) — any compliance flags for benchmark claims?
Ed: quick check — benchmarks are internal but ok if phrased as "Based on internal analysis". Approve.
Tia: SDR ops: can we add slack alerts to #sales when a high-intent lead comes in? Need a webhook.
Ben: Yep — I'll configure webhook to post a brief summary to #sales-campaigns with lead score and contact.
Sophie: Final asks: who owns post-launch engagement 2 hours after publish? Need someone to triage replies and route high-touch convo to SDRs.
Margot: I'll monitor for the first 3 hours, coordinate replies, then hand off to SDRs for deeper convos.
Luis: Pushing final assets to GDrive: https://drive.example/launch/v1 (folders: hero, screenshots, clips)
Ben: Also adding a short thread checklist to Buffer notes: 
- Add UTM to all links
- Attach mobile hero when posting
- Pin webinar reg link in top reply
Sophie: Awesome. I'll update the launch playbook doc with these steps and confirm calendar times. Thanks team! :rocket:
